dedupe_keys.name: representative lv distribution power grid models for austria

description: Giourgkert Partalis at the Austrian Institute of Technology publishes automatically generated low-voltage network models for five Austrian areas. Zenodo provides the ZIP freely under CC BY 4.0. Each area contains load and photovoltaic profiles, graph and pandapower pickle files, CSV asset tables for lines, loads and transformers, and map outputs. Models were generated from open inputs using competitive Louvain community detection. These networks can support comparative power-flow and hosting-capacity simulations. Related catalogue model-pandapower provides the solver environment, without explicitly covering these Austrian cases. Coverage is representative generated networks, not verified as-built utility topology. Input-map completeness, graph-generation choices and profile assumptions introduce uncertainty. The deposit does not fully specify software versions, temporal resolution or validation against operator records. No archive was downloaded, pickle loaded or network solved.
